title: Inherent
summary: INHE'RENT, adjective Existing in something else, so as to be inseparable from it. Inherent baseness. 1. Innate; naturally pertaining to; as the inherent qualities of the magnet; the inherent right of

inlines.v: INHE'RENT, adjective Existing in something else, so as to be inseparable from it. Inherent baseness. 1. Innate; naturally pertaining to; as the inherent qualities of the magnet; the inherent right of men to life, liberty and protection.
